items: A work permit must be issued,
The qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area,
Check for wear.
The O rings and seals must be renewed.

The remaining parts are to be renewed when this 
 becomes necessary only.

Dismantling is always carried out with the isolator 
 open and in the following order seem from the operating side fig 2
Set the safety lock 25682 to overhauls.

Remove the operating mechanism cover 25681 and 
 after undoing the screws 25685 take off the mechanism.

Detach the operating mechanism cover 25650 from the 
 enclosure of the isolator.
Remove the insulating shaft 25625.

After undoing the screw 25607 .take off the 
 long screen 25606.

unscrew the short screen 25604 with the aid of the 
 extension 02038 by real sing screws 25605 and place on a suitable 
 support (rubber sheet) on the bottom of the enclosure.

Support the intermediate section 25638 on the 
 enclosure (flange) by means of the device 02032.

Release the tulip attachment 25637 from the tubular 
 contact carrier by means of the special ratchet 02040 release screws 25637. 
 and with the tulip contact in the tubular conductor push up to the stop.

Remove the screw from the fixing of the tubular 
 contact 25615.

Screw the holding device 02034 to
 the fixing of the tubular contact and enclosure flange with screws 25603 .

Detach the tubular contact carrier 25618 from 
 the base carrier (undoing screws 25641 by means of the special ratchet and 
 then removing them) then remove the screwed joint 25603 between the 
 holding device and the enclosure flange.

Push the tubular contact carrier, including the 
 holding device out of its centering and remove altogether then the short 
 screen can be taken out.

Release the fixed contact 25660 with box spanner 
 02036 and remove
Clean and lubricating parts
Reassembly the parts in correct position.
Refill the isolator according to condition of SF6.
Check the isolator (open-close)
Make contact test and scheduled the result.
